ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with a predominant low-intensity (black/dark-gray) central region covering approximately 70-75% of the surface area and high-intensity (white) regions concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark-intensity contiguous blob across the central and medial fluke surface; two distinct high-intensity (white) patches located at the left and right terminal ends, containing a high density of small, dark-intensity circular inclusions (mottling).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Observed high-frequency serration across the continuous trailing edge; characterized by low-to-medium amplitude peaks and valleys along the entire visible boundary, contrasting sharply with the sea background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe sweep exhibits an upward concave curve starting from the medial region, transitioning to a convex arc at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive detection of circular and semi-circular high-contrast pixel clusters (annular rings) distributed across both the dark central region and white terminal patches, indicating high-density colonization or scarring patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible as thin high-intensity lines across the dark-intensity pigmentation of the central and right lobe regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant concentration of circular barnacle-related scarring and distinct white linear rake marks across the fluke surface.
